literal: To think rejoicing and to see gladdening to liquor is not, to love exists.
translation: Merely thinking of it brings intoxication, and seeing it brings joy; this is true of love, but not of liquor.
modern: நினைத்தாலேயே போதை தருவதும், பார்த்தாலேயே மகிழ்ச்சி தருவதும் காதலுக்கு மட்டுமே உண்டு; மதுவுக்கு அந்த இயல்பு இல்லை.
explanation: The couplet contrasts the effects of love with those of intoxicating liquor. Liquor can only intoxicate when it is actually consumed. Love, however, is so powerful that merely thinking about the beloved brings a rush of intoxication, and simply seeing them brings immense joy. The words 'உள்ள' (to think) and 'காண' (to see) highlight how love affects the mind and senses even without physical union.
